title: Rainbow Frogs
description: Add red, blue, yellow, and rainbow frogs with their associated froglights
body:
Rainbow Frogs

![All Frogs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FF0pAMHO/images/e18483e790ec422fc9a248cd051064da0b1da56b.png)

Frogs:

Red Poison

![Red Poison Frog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FF0pAMHO/images/0cf710cb3b9cc9926a03eb1c47958d283ffebe3e.png)

In order to get the Red Poison Frog, you have to breed warm and temperate frogs together. When it eats a Magma Cube, it drops a Vermillion Froglight Block.

Blue Poison Dart

![Blue Poison Dart Frog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FF0pAMHO/images/040f9d1169e0d44f6e166e9cdf95b550a1e39850.png)

In order to get the Blue Poison Dart Frog, you have to breed cold and warm frogs together. When it eats a Magma Cube, it drops a Cerulean Froglight Block.

Bumblebee

![Bumblebee Frog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FF0pAMHO/images/42f49390d86afa6f5bc2923d453efaa0e10a8e4e.png)

In order to get the Bumblebee Frog, you have to breed cold and temperate frogs together. When it eats a Magma Cube, it drops a Goldenrod Froglight Block.

Rainbow

![Rainbow Frog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FF0pAMHO/images/dfe8a69104359cc01c1aa8d96e21f8f9eea2b031.png)

In order to get the Rainbow Frog, you have to craft a rainbow tadpole and let that grow into a Rainbow Frog. When it eats a Magma Cube, it drops a random Froglight Block.
